usage: sot-validator [-h]
                     {extract,validate,report,run,history,quarantine,remediate,reconcile,campaign,preflight,reclaim-ports,export-modern-sot,migrate-export,parity-check,migration-parity,ups-health,itsm,itsm-sync,discover,serve,curate,topology,fingerprint,map-ports,diff-scans} ...

Read-only batch inventory validation system for legacy Network Source of Truth.

positional arguments:
  {extract,validate,report,run,history,quarantine,remediate,reconcile,campaign,preflight,reclaim-ports,export-modern-sot,migrate-export,parity-check,migration-parity,ups-health,itsm,itsm-sync,discover,serve,curate,topology,fingerprint,map-ports,diff-scans}
    extract             Extract read-only site inventory batches into local snapshots.
    validate            Evaluate passive, hypervisor, directory/DNS, and scoped active signals
                        against site snapshots.
    report              Generate JSON, CSV, Markdown, and optional interactive HTML validation
                        reports.
    run                 Execute end-to-end extraction, signal validation, multi-format reporting,
                        and Phase 2 dry-run plan generation.
    history             Record validation runs in HistoryStore, query stale streaks, and analyze
                        state-transition drift.
    quarantine          Evaluate stale streaks against QuarantinePolicy and generate/approve
                        SHA-256 signed manifests.
    remediate           Execute a SHA-256-verified RemediationApprovalManifest or generate/apply
                        rollback plans.
    reconcile           Reconcile live vCenter, SNMP, ARP, and ICMP discovery feeds against SoT
                        snapshots to surface untracked assets.
    campaign            Execute rolling multi-site validation waves with outage circuit breakers
                        and alert sinks.
    preflight           Run pre-flight cutover readiness checks verifying /24 scoping, read-only
                        guardrails, and endpoint credentials.
    reclaim-ports       Generate staged dry-run Extreme Networks switch port & PoE reclamation
                        plans with LLDP Uplink Guard.
    export-modern-sot (migrate-export)
                        Export golden validated inventory into normalized NetBox or Nautobot JSON
                        and CSV bundles.
    parity-check (migration-parity)
                        Evaluate dual-run parity and per-site migration readiness scorecards
                        between legacy and modern SoT.
    ups-health          Evaluate APC UPS PowerNet-MIB battery replacement, runtime, load, and
                        thermal health across sites.
    itsm (itsm-sync)    Generate, approve, serialize, and verify ServiceNow/Jira/Webhook ITSM
                        change tickets.
    discover            Run two-stage /16-to-/24 subnet discovery and bootstrap a canonical Site
                        snapshot.
    serve               Launch the interactive Web Workbench HTTP server and REST API.
    curate              Apply operator inventory patches, instantiate template devices, manage
                        switch ports, and inspect audit logs.
    topology            Build a site network TopologyGraph (with optional curation overlay) and
                        export JSON and Mermaid diagrams.
    fingerprint         Fingerprint vendor/model/OS from collected SSH/HTTP/TLS/SNMP banners and
                        enrich a site snapshot (no network I/O).
    map-ports           Map switch FDB / MAC tables to ports, infer access/trunk/uplink modes, and
                        bind downstream MACs.
    diff-scans          Diff two discovery site snapshots and optionally dispatch drift alerts.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
